## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%) and only Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%); credit stress via HYG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -0.73%) and LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.28%) is rising while VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.55% | 1M: -7.10%) shows short-term pick-up in volatility — together justify a neutral read.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -0.73%) and LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.28%) BOTH BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress ↑). Volatility mixed: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.55% | 1M: -7.10%) ↑ rising while VIX flat (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -6.64%) → neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: Dollar flat (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -0.14%) and Yield-sensitive TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -1.13%) both showing no clear easing; duration preference muted (duration metric flat) → financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%). Tech in RECOVERY: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.91% | 1M: -0.63%). Style mixed / no clear leadership given 1/11 breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US lagging: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%). EM showing relative resilience: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +2.08%). China soft: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -2.10%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed speculation: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -5.57% | 1M: +21.96%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -4.09% | 1M: +2.72%) show profit-taking inside longer-term strength; IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -4.57%) signals small-cap caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity-led cyclical: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.02% | 1M: +21.68%) and PDBC ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +10.13%) drive the commodity bid; CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -2.10%) lags.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) and Brent BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%); gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -0.29%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and EM (EEM ABOVE TREND) show clean two-horizon strength. Divergence: XLK RECOVERY (1W up | 1M down) is a MINOR divergence vs SPY/TLT which are BOTH BELOW TREND — monitor for escalation.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and commodity-linked ETFs (XLE (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%), BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%)) while reducing exposure to broad US equity beta and duration risk (SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -1.06%), TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -1.13%)); monitor IBIT and ARKK for speculative retracement.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +6.73%) and commodity proxies USO/BNO ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Healthcare XBI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -2.00%) and Industrials XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -7.27%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil (USO (1W: +9.02% | 1M: +21.68%), BNO (1W: +9.79% | 1M: +21.00%)) on momentum.  
BEARISH: Copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -2.10%) and Natural Gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -0.29%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (vol complacency threshold) — VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.55% | 1M: -7.10%). HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit health) — HYG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -0.73%) & LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.28%) BOTH BELOW TREND. XLK/XLF ratio 3.28 (watch for growth/value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive, with Energy the lone clear leader and credit spreads showing stress. XLE and commodity ETFs showing strength while XLK RECOVERY and rising short-term volatility are the key divergences to monitor.
